source_evidence: This search tool enables you to check out SEC- and state-registered investment adviser firms and the individuals who work for them.
answer: Investment Adviser Public Disclosure (IAPD) is a search tool for researching SEC- and state-registered investment adviser firms and the people who work for them. It can show registration status and background information, including business practices, fees, conflicts of interest, disciplinary history, and an individual’s qualifications and employment history. You can also read a firm’s Form ADV, which describes the adviser and its services.
